- **Course Category Tabs** — Click any tab to filter the course grid instantly
- **Teacher Carousel** — Left/right arrow buttons smooth-scroll the horizontal teacher list

- **Fonts**: Plus Jakarta Sans (headlines) + Inter (body)
- **Colors**: Deep navy hero (`#0F0F1A`), accent green (`#55DA9B`), accent purple (`#5620C1`), coral, yellow
- **Responsive**: Fully responsive with breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px
- **SEO**: Complete `<head>` with meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD Organization & FAQPage schema
